# Support SLA

| Priority | First response | Resolution target |
|---|---|---|
| P1 (service down) | 15 minutes | 4 hours |
| P2 (major degradation) | 1 hour | 1 business day |
| P3 (minor issue) | 4 business hours | 5 business days |
| P4 (question) | 1 business day | best effort |

Notes:
- P1 is supported 24x7; P2-P4 only 09:00-18:00 on business days.
- Response clocks pause while we wait for the customer.
- Customers on the Premium plan get P2 first response of 30 minutes.

turns.prompt: A Premium customer reports a major degradation. What is our first-response time for them?
And what is the resolution target for that same ticket?
